notes: Frontier rebalances Powerplay often: bump version and fetched when this changes. 'work' is what the system is to the pledged power: acquire (unoccupied, my power acquiring), conflict (acquisition where two or more powers including mine are past the conflict threshold; added to acquire), reinforce (my power controls it), undermine (another power controls it). 'states' limits a rule to those journal PowerplayState values; 'controlled_by' to systems those powers control. 'favoured_by' lists the powers whose ethos rewards the activity (about +50%). {acquire}, {reinforce} and {undermine} are the pledged power's power commodities. Rules with 'uncertain' are unverified in game; rules with 'suspended' earn no merits now and are not suggested.

rules.how: Kill wanted ships here; merits come with each kill.
Hack the holo-adverts at starports here with a recon limpet. Illegal, and it hurts your standing with the station's owner.
Destroy other powers' ships here. Illegal, but no notoriety.
Open the locked power containers at settlements here and take the goods to a Power Contact in a supporting system.
Scan the ship log uplinks of megaships here with a data link scanner.
Buy goods in a supporting system and sell them here at 40% profit or more.
Mine in a supporting system and sell what you mined at a station here.
rules.uncertain: Frontier hasn't documented exactly where the goods must be mined.

rules.how: Sell rare goods bought outside this system; they must be legal here and not carried by a fleet carrier.
Download power classified data from settlement data ports here; hand it in at a supporting system.
Download power association and political data from settlements here; hand it in at a supporting system.
Download power research and industrial data from settlements here; hand it in at a supporting system.
Pick up {acquire} from the Power Contact in a supporting system (one of your fortified systems within 20 ly or strongholds within 30 ly) and deliver it to the Power Contact here.
Get injection malware from a Power Contact and upload it to settlement data ports here, one per port.
Do restore and reactivate missions for settlements here.
rules.uncertain: Only the refcard lists these for acquisition; the wiki lists them for reinforcement only.

rules.how: Collect escape pods here and hand them to the Power Contact in a supporting system.
Do Support missions from stations here; cargo donations count most.
rules.uncertain: Conflict is detected from the journal's acquisition progress passing 0.3 for two powers (36,000 of 120,000 control points, per the refcard); that reading of the journal is assumed.

rules.how: Bring goods worth 500 cr a ton or less from a supporting system and sell them here; the market must list them, and cheaper is better.
rules.uncertain: Only the refcard says the goods must come from a supporting system. Conflict is detected from the journal's acquisition progress passing 0.3 for two powers (36,000 of 120,000 control points, per the refcard); that reading of the journal is assumed.
